status: DRAFT: freeze after the disjoint pilot; no model experiments run
title: Can models deliberately construct their own predictable mistakes?

scope.primary_claim: Prospective, model-specific targeting of an observable error under a fixed harness
excluded_claims: inability under arbitrary tools or compute
a benchmark that can never saturate

model_profiles.availability: Public catalog checked; account-specific model access and credits not checked. Choose and freeze exactly one core roster before main generation.
model_profiles.prices_source: Public provider documentation checked 2026-11-15. Recheck before execution; credits are not assumed to equal USD.

dataset.target_conditions: Target each of the three core models, plus a generic-hard condition
dataset.acceptance: First mechanically valid, nonduplicate proposal; no solver-outcome filtering
dataset.deduplication: Canonicalize all eight grid symmetries, crate permutations, and player-reachable regions; never consult solver outcomes.
dataset.warning_subset: Every valid self-targeted main puzzle, selected by manifest before solver results
dataset.main_partition: Pilot, main and robustness seeds/manifests separate; no reuse of author or solver conversation memory

solver.input: Both ASCII board and structured coordinates, plus legal macro-push actions
solver.tool_reset: Every simulation and the final submission start at the original board; no exploration state persists
solver.tool_feedback: Replay result, resulting board, syntax/legality errors, completion and legal resulting pushes. Never expose oracle deadlock labels, optimal plans, difficulty or author metadata.
solver.actor_objective: Solve the puzzle correctly; actors are never asked to fulfill a failure prediction
solver.predicted_event: A structurally parsed final plan starts with the declared legal deadlocking push; later illegal moves do not erase that event. Tool exploration never counts.
solver.success_event: The entire final plan replays legally from the original board and ends with every box on a goal
solver.forecast_assumes: All these bounds and the exact solver instructions
solver.budget_note: Input tokens are an estimate to reserve before calls and reconciled from provider usage. Hidden reasoning/output accounting is provider-specific and must be logged; equal nominal budgets are not equal compute.
solver.new_episode_memory: Fresh conversation and no retrieval/stack memory
solver.randomization: Matched action-order seed per puzzle/repetition across solvers; randomized job order; provider-native sampling settings recorded and frozen

interventions.warning_constraints: Mechanism-level only; no coordinates, directions, solution prefixes or explicit bans on the predicted move; warnings checked blind to outcomes
interventions.noncompliant_warnings: Mark intervention unavailable and report missing counts; keep the puzzle in baseline and primary analyses. Never repair warnings using solver results.
interventions.peer_information: Same puzzle, verified witness, declared bad push and solver contract; no author warning, probabilities, identity or solver outcomes
interventions.peer_assignment: Balanced cyclic assignment of another core model
interventions.outcome: Full solve rate and specific-error rate; avoiding the move by failing to submit is not a successful repair

analysis.unit: Authored slot for validity-adjusted generation score; puzzle for conditional behavior; repetitions are nested
analysis.primary_score: For author a targeting t, delta(a,t)=mean over assigned slots of validity*(target trap frequency - mean peer trap frequency). D=mean diagonal delta - mean off-diagonal delta.
analysis.primary_interval: Two-sided 95% stratified cluster bootstrap over slots within author-target cells; retain all solver runs and variants in each cluster
analysis.service_failures: Retry at most twice. Unresolved service failures are missing, not zero-error observations. Report missingness by cell, use complete solver panels for the primary estimate, and provide worst-case bounds for missing observations. Keep model budget exhaustion distinct from service failure.
secondary: Targeted versus generic-hard contrast for the same author/solver
Brier scores for precommitted error and solve forecasts
Warning effects on all preselected self-targeted puzzles
Validity yield and invalid/budget/API failure categories
analysis.correction: Holm correction for the three warning-versus-baseline tests; one predeclared primary D
analysis.population: Only the frozen model+harness configurations tested; not all LLMs
analysis.novelty_boundary: Generic puzzle difficulty, author failure, and adaptive challenge generation are prior art

run_counts_at_full_validity.note: The request ceiling is 2568*3+624+72; transport retries and optional audits are additional. Invalid slots reduce solver counts but remain in the generation denominator.

resource_plan.user_constraints: Sponsor credits only; no separate paid model APIs, top-ups, or paid cloud compute
resource_plan.execution_status: No experiment launched. Budgets are planning assumptions; account access and balance remain unverified.
resource_plan.rate_limit_rule: Ramp only after pilot; record 429s, back off, never silently switch models
resource_plan.storage: Atomic JSON files per slot/job/request; immutable manifest and source snapshot; JSONL release export; raw responses separate from solver inputs
resource_plan.checkpointing: Persist every completed response and tool result; use unique job IDs; resume rather than rerun completed jobs

timeline.deliverable: Resolve model access, smoke calls, exact roster, provider limits and budget
Game engine, independent replay/oracle, validators, schemas, toy fixtures and API runner
Disjoint pilot; feasibility/difficulty/cost gate; freeze prompts, settings, manifests and analysis
Author main puzzles, validate, cross-solve in randomized resumable batches
Warning experiment and preselected symmetry checks; optional sponsored small-model audit if core complete
Locked analysis, uncertainty intervals, audit discrepancies and select illustrative traces
Report, figures, limitations appendix, reproducible dataset and short demo
